Dream 2026-11-22 linked 4 vignettes from 2 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-10-30 · retells · "present me with options and a rationale. What are the trade-offs for each path?" (Vignette 2026-10-30: the first iteration of a registry, lock down only the smallest piece)
- 2026-11-05 · retells · "present decisions - with information that is relevant in the context of the decision" (Owner: present decisions with what is relevant in their context; incompatible answers serving different remedies are gold for the research (2026-11-05))
- 2026-11-05 · retells · "They don't really present me with the information I need to be able to judge them. So I tend to just click "recommended"" (Owner: decisions are very hard to judge, so I tend to just click "recommended" (2026-11-05))
- 2026-11-05 · retells · "we need to be better at explaining the consequences, rather than the specifics" (Owner: explain a technical decision's strategic consequences, not its specifics (2026-11-05))
